liveFindingsThisCheckpoint.summary: CI's own Typecheck job (`pnpm --filter property-explorer exec tsc --noEmit`) only checks the root tsconfig.json's `include: ['src']` -- it never actually type-checks apps/property-explorer/api/**, which has its own api/tsconfig.json (same strict settings) that job never targets. PR #387's green CI therefore never exercised api/'s type-checking at all.
liveFindingsThisCheckpoint.caughtBy: Running `vercel deploy` locally after the PR-387 merge (its per-function build does type-check api/) surfaced 4 real errors in this lane's new files that CI's own gate had missed.
liveFindingsThisCheckpoint.fix: PR #388: two excess-property errors (FloodHazardFactWire/SpecialDistrictFactWire declare no top-level `reason` field), one unused function, one overly-loose test fixture type. `npx tsc --noEmit -p api` now reports only 3 pre-existing, unrelated errors (verdict-layer-merge.ts x2, pe-share-grant.ts x1 -- confirmed not introduced by this lane, not fixed here, named for whoever owns CI config next).
liveFindingsThisCheckpoint.classOfDefect: A gate that cannot fail for the right reason (DEV_PROCESS) -- the Typecheck job's own scope silently excludes the directory this lane's entire mission lives in.

liveFindingsThisCheckpoint.summary: First production deploy's five-parcel anonymous pre/post diff showed every composed fact's VALUE identical to the pre-change baseline on four of five probe parcels, but the `source` field differed on every present/absent composed fact: this lane's composers hardcoded a generic 'parcel_record' string where cortex's own parcel_record-fed adapters (already live, already correct, per lane 1) stamp a fact-family-specific constant (e.g. 'flood-hazard-fact', not 'parcel_record').
liveFindingsThisCheckpoint.caughtBy: The mandated live pre/post diff itself, run before declaring success -- not by any unit test, since the unit tests asserted the same (wrong) generic string the implementation used.
liveFindingsThisCheckpoint.fix: PR #389: vendored the exact source-constant strings from legacy-design-tools' <rail>FactRead.ts modules for all eight companion families. cityLimitsFact was already correct (tx_city_boundary) and needed no change.
liveFindingsThisCheckpoint.classOfDefect: Falsifier violated on its own explicit terms ('value, source, or vintage') -- caught because the falsifier was actually run against production, not assumed satisfied because the code looked right and unit tests passed.

liveFindingsThisCheckpoint.summary: Same live diff, re-run after F-P152PANEL-2's fix: floodHazardFact.floodZone was missing entirely on every present flood fact (present pre-change as 'X'/'AE'). Root cause: flood is a COMPANION rail (parcel-record-rail-registry.ts grain 'companion') -- a 'value' cell's zone lives on the companion row's payload.zone, never on the cell_state itself. This lane's first pass read cell.raw.floodZone, a field that does not exist on this rail's cell_state, and silently produced a present fact with an absent zone rather than refusing.
liveFindingsThisCheckpoint.caughtBy: The same mandated live diff, a second pass after the source-label fix -- confirms the diff-then-fix-then-re-diff loop is load-bearing, not a one-shot check.
liveFindingsThisCheckpoint.fix: PR #390: read the companion row (mirrors legacy-design-tools' parcelRecordFactRead.ts loadParcelRecordFloodFact exactly); a malformed/missing companion row now refuses rather than silently omitting the zone. Also restored agValuationFact.entries' full vendored field set (an earlier unforced simplification) and normalized absent-branch sourceVintage to null (matching cortex's wire byte-for-byte) instead of undefined.
liveFindingsThisCheckpoint.classOfDefect: Vacuous-looking success -- the code ran, returned 200, and LOOKED like a present fact; only a live value diff against the real store revealed the value itself was silently incomplete.
